title: Beyond Chatbots: Building Interoperable AI with the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF)
description: As AI shifts toward fully autonomous systems, the community faces a critical challenge: breaking down vendor silos. In this quick 10-minute lightning talk, open-source tech founder [**Steven Mih**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/stevenmih) introduces the Linux Foundation’s [**Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF)**](https://aaif.io/). He will map out how the foundational open building blocks—such as Anthropic’s Model Context Protocol (MCP), OpenAI's [AGENTS.md](http://AGENTS.md), and Block's Goose—are providing developers worldwide with a modular, vendor-neutral blueprint to build multi-agent ecosystems that seamlessly scale.
